title: Course Schedule II (LC 210)
approach: Applied Kahn's algorithm with an in-degree array and queue. Detected cycles early by comparing processed node count against total courses.

title: Coin Change (LC 322)
approach: Constructed bottom-up 1D DP table initialized to amount + 1. Iterated through each denomination to find optimal subproblem combination in O(amount * n).

title: Trapping Rain Water (LC 42)
approach: Used two converging pointers tracking max-left and max-right boundaries. Trapped water is determined deterministically by the smaller boundary in O(1) auxiliary space.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree (LC 236)
approach: Post-order recursive traversal returning node when found. If both left and right subtrees return non-null, the current root is the LCA.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters (LC 3)
approach: Maintained sliding window with character index hash map. Fast-forwarded left pointer past the last duplicate occurrence to guarantee linear O(n) traversal.

title: Merge k Sorted Lists (LC 23)
approach: Maintained min-heap of current head pointers across k lists. Popped minimum node and pushed its successor in O(N log k) total runtime.
